source: По темам армянских учебников математики для 5 класса

stages.headline: Сколько минут в четверти часа?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many minutes are a quarter of an hour?
stages.problemText: How many minutes are a quarter of an hour?

stages.headline: Сколько сантиметров в пятой части метра?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many centimetres are a fifth of a metre?
stages.problemText: How many centimetres are a fifth of a metre?

stages.headline: Седьмая часть числа равна 8. Найди это число.
stages.headlineEnglish: A seventh of a number is 8. Find the number.
stages.problemText: A seventh of a number is 8. Find the number.

stages.headline: В книге 240 страниц. Ученик прочитал три восьмых книги. Сколько страниц осталось прочитать?
stages.headlineEnglish: A book has 240 pages; a pupil read three eighths of it. How many pages are left?
stages.problemText: A book has 240 pages; a pupil read three eighths of it. How many pages are left?

stages.headline: Две трети дороги составляют 18 км. Какова длина всей дороги?
stages.headlineEnglish: Two thirds of a road is 18 km. How long is the road?
stages.problemText: Two thirds of a road is 18 km. How long is the road?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Одна треть: 18 : 2 = 9 км. 2. Вся дорога: 9 · 3 = 27 км.
